title: Car fried by energy weapon en route to filming implant test
place_text: canyon on the way to Dr. builder's office

tellings.quote: [sighs and gasps] they um zapped my car with some kind of an energy weapon when I was um uh going to Dr. builder's office to um uh film um uh him um testing the implant while it was still in the body. And um uh the mechanic said later that the the computer in the car was fried like it was exposed to EMP or something.

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies alleged alien implants (small objects people say were placed in their bodies), tells Michels that someone zapped his car with "some kind of an energy weapon" as he drove through a canyon to the office of a doctor he calls Dr. Builder, where he meant to film the doctor testing an implant still inside a patient's body. He says a mechanic later told him the car's computer was fried as if hit by an EMP, an electromagnetic pulse that knocks out electronics. If true, someone was trying to stop that test from being recorded.
